notes: Night skip and fast travel (P5) are Palworld's, not RimWorld's, so every number is ours. A visited block is 8 m wide and the controlled colonist marks the blocks within 16 m of it. Fast travel takes the walk's time (the straight line times 1.3 at the colonist's own speed, in game seconds) and refuses places closer than 20 m. A skip runs 1200 (night) or 120 (travel) game seconds per Sim::step and looks for a threat every 10 game seconds. Animals stand still in a night skip.
